detail.title: Mechanisms of Curiosity: From Psychology to Artificial Systems
detail.summary: Curiosity in AI can be modeled as an information-gain mechanism, but recent research suggests it also acts as a coordination mechanism in multi-agent systems, where 'curiosity' calibrates exploration in sparse-reward environments.
detail.reason: Updates the existing notebook to incorporate newly collected research on multi-agent curiosity mechanisms.
